punchline: Gmail's one-gigabyte promise ran on 300 old machines that nobody else wanted.
thirty_sec: Google announced Gmail on April Fools' Day 2004, offering 1 GB per account when rivals held a few dozen emails, and plenty of people thought it was a joke. Paul Buchheit says they launched on 300 old machines with room for only 10,000 users. Invitations then sold for $250 on eBay.
